title: Code block
description: Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button and an optional title (file name); long lines scroll sideways. Plain text, no highlighting.
when: API keys and commands to copy, config snippets, developer docs.

instead.use: <code> in text, or Kbd for keys

a11y: The block is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it; the copy button is labelled and says when it copied.
